item.tib: rtsa sgrab las chog kha tshar las me mchod bdud rtsi thig pa'i las byang
item.coloph: zhes me mchod bdud rtsi thig pa zhes bya ba 'di yang / dad ldan slob ma rnams kyis bskul ba la brten nas/ khyung dkar sprang 'khyams bstan 'dzin rin chen 'bod pas gang dran 'di rnams gnas chen yol mo gangs ra zhes/ sbas yul pad ma tshal gyi nags 'dabs rgya gar b+had+ha b+hilI sgrub gnas yang dag mchog gi gsang du smras pa bkra shis su gyur cig/
